test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

“Have you ever thought how difficult it is for the migrants to earn these days?” father asked his son.

options.text: Father had asked his son if he ever thought how difficult it was for the migrants to earned those days.
Father asked his son whether he had ever thought how difficult it was for the migrants to earn those days.
Father asks his son if he has ever thought how difficult it was for the migrants to earn these days.
Father asked his son if he has ever thought how difficult it is for the migrants to earn these days.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Father asked his son whether he had ever thought how difficult it was for the migrants to earn those days.**'
